name: kiro-herdr-views
description: A long-lived terminal-session panel for the Crew dashboard. Attach to real, interactive tmux / screen / zellij / herdr / agent-of-empires sessions running on your host (and later, remote hosts) — a Herdr or agent-of-empires style view, in a web page.
author: you

setup.onInstall: cd ui && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && npm install --omit=dev
setup.onUpdate: cd ui && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && npm install --omit=dev
